svg.title: Blind Oedipus seated at an altar between his daughters, Ismene and Antigone
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Apulian red-figure calyx-krater close to the De Schulthess Painter, 340s BCE, formerly Melbourne, Geddes collection A 5:8, read as a scene from Sophocles' Oedipus at Colonus (Taplin, Pots & Plays no. 27); traced from photographs, chiefly those in J. R. Green, Ancient Voices, Modern Echoes (2003): cut out, columns left out, redrawn as line.
